SELECT COUNT(IN_TB.EMP_CD) FROM( SELECT X.EMP_CD, X.EMP_NM, DEPT_CD, (SELECT DEPT_NM FROM KYERP.TB_HR_DEPARTMENT AA WHERE AA.DEPT_CD = Y.DEPT_CD AND END_YMD = '99991231' ) DEPT_NM, MOBILE_NO
FROM KYERP.TB_HR_EMPLOYEE X, (SELECT A.EMP_CD,DEPT_CD,DEPT_DUTY FROM KYERP.TB_HR_PERS_APPOINTMENTS A , ( SELECT DISTINCT EMP_CD, MAX (DOCUMENT_NO) AS DOCUMENT_NO FROM KYERP.TB_HR_PERS_APPOINTMENTS GROUP BY EMP_CD ) B WHERE A.EMP_CD = B.EMP_CD AND A.DOCUMENT_NO = B.DOCUMENT_NO ) Y WHERE X.EMP_CD = Y.EMP_CD

SELECT IN_TB.* FROM( SELECT X.EMP_CD AS EMP_NO, X.EMP_NM, DEPT_CD, (SELECT DEPT_NM FROM KYERP.TB_HR_DEPARTMENT AA WHERE AA.DEPT_CD = Y.DEPT_CD AND END_YMD = '99991231' ) DEPT_NM, MOBILE_NO , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY X.EMP_NM ) AS RNUM FROM KYERP.TB_HR_EMPLOYEE X, (SELECT A.EMP_CD,DEPT_CD,DEPT_DUTY FROM KYERP.TB_HR_PERS_APPOINTMENTS A , ( SELECT DISTINCT EMP_CD, MAX (DOCUMENT_NO) AS DOCUMENT_NO FROM KYERP.TB_HR_PERS_APPOINTMENTS GROUP BY EMP_CD ) B WHERE A.EMP_CD = B.EMP_CD AND A.DOCUMENT_NO = B.DOCUMENT_NO ) Y WHERE X.EMP_CD = Y.EMP_CD
AND UPPER(X.EMP_NM) LIKE '%'|| UPPER(#{search_text}) ||'%'
ORDER BY 1 ) IN_TB WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY RNUM DESC
